description: Evaluation cases for the Aventra support assistant. 'expected_docs': retrieval hit@k counts a hit when any of these doc ids appears in the top-k. 'must_contain': groups of alternatives; the draft must contain at least one term from every group (case-insensitive). 'expect_refusal': the pipeline must end in a refusal event for this case.
